critic.fix_suggestion: Create an array of 40 small rectangular planes (dimensions: 0.5m x 0.3m) along the fuselage's longitudinal axis. Position them at a constant interval of 1.2m starting from the cockpit, rotating each plane to match the local curvature of the cylindrical hull geometry to ensure they follow the fuselage profile.
